name: Beet Webworm Moth
desc: Beet Webworm Moth (Spoladea recurvalis): eats plants or other primary food sources. Recorded 2 times near the park in GBIF.
about: Spoladea recurvalis, the beet webworm moth or Hawaiian beet webworm moth, is a species of moth of the family Crambidae. It is found worldwide, but mainly in the tropics.
